thread:
michelle (PM): Quick sync — we have 3 customer asks (Acme, NovaHealth, FinSider) pushing for stronger multi-region routing + tenant isolation guarantees. Need to align on roadmap slipstreaming vs separate pilot. TL;DR: customers want predictable failover, per-tenant routing policy, and a canary plan.
anya (Architect): Noted. We should separate policy surface: (1) routing precedence + fallbacks, (2) tenant isolation lanes, (3) cutover acceptance criteria. Each has different infra and SLO implications.
raj (SRE): From ops POV, biggest risk is cross-region KV replication for cache warm starts and burst capacity. We need clear runbooks for emergency cutovers.
derek (Eng): Can we scope a minimal MVP for routing policies? Proposal: sticky-affinity by session -> region preference -> fallback region. Keep model variant fallback out of scope for MVP.
michelle (PM): MVP sounds right. Customer asks include: per-tenant residency tag, SLA for failover <250ms (per request routing decision, not warm KV), observable trace for routing decision. Add that to acceptance.
leo (Product Ops): Also call out rollout constraints: Dedicated customers should be able to opt into pilot without code changes. Config + API flag only.
eva (Solutions): For NovaHealth we need compliance doc showing private deployment compatibility. If pilot touches Private plane, legal will want key-management notes.
anya (Architect): Agreed. Sketching launch criteria checklist: \n```
- Policy DSL stable and documented
- Canary routing for 5% of traffic (non-critical tenants)
- KV prefix caching warm start < 1s for cold requests
- Per-tenant telemetry + cost attribution enabled
- Rollback plan and automated fallback policy
```
If any item fails, abort cutover.
raj (SRE): Add chaos test: sim multi-region outage and confirm no more than 5% request failure for pilot tenants. Also define throttling behavior under egress limits.
derek (Eng): Blockers: need cross-region routing table service and a lightweight policy evaluator in the edge path. I estimate 3 sprints for PoC, +2 sprints for hardening.
michelle (PM): Timeline check — customers want pilot in Q3. Is that realistic?
anya (Architect): Q3 pilot doable if we: fast-track policy evaluator + reuse existing KV replication (but tune for prefix caching). We'll need dedicated infra tickets and a smoke test suite.
leo (Product Ops): I'll draft customer opt-in terms and a pilot onboarding checklist.
eva (Solutions): I'll coordinate NovaHealth compliance questions; need a KMS/HSM mapping doc.
derek (Eng): Action items for eng: create RFC for policy DSL, spike on edge evaluator, and infra ticket for cross-region table. I’ll own RFC.
michelle (PM): Good. michelle -> creating roadmap epic and linking RFC. Owners: derek (RFC/eng), anya (architecture), raj (SRE runbooks), leo (pilot ops), eva (customer compliance).
build-bot: deploy pipeline for routing-evaluator-PoC created: https://ci.internal/3291234000/build/12 :white_check_mark:
michelle (PM): Next steps: derek to post RFC by EOD Friday, anya to post acceptance criteria doc, leo to prepare pilot opt-in email. Meeting to sync Friday 09:30 PT. :calendar: :thumbsup:
